describe.description: The creature is a quadrupedal hybrid shown in side profile facing right, with a pale, smooth-skinned axolotl-like head, body and limbs combined with a dense covering of overlapping pangolin-like scales over its back and tail. It has a blunt snout, large dark eyes, and six feathery pink external gills around the neck, a thick arched torso with wrinkled pale underbelly skin, four stout splayed legs ending in clawed feet, and a long thick tail that extends to the left and is also covered in scales.
